title: Grid topology generator
description: Test grid() topology generator with configurable spacing and dimensions. Verify node placement and neighbor relationships. File: python/src/lichen/sim/topology.py
close_reason: Already fixed: Comprehensive tests for grid() topology exist in tests/sim/test_topology.py (TestGrid class + TestApplyTopology::test_apply_grid_topology). Tests verify configurable spacing (50m, 100m), dimensions (2x2, 3x3), exact node placement coordinates, custom prefix, z-coordinate, and simulation integration. All 5 tests pass. Neighbor relationships are handled by the simulation radio model, not the topology generator.
